description:
Read one record by GID from one store. Follow each returned cursor independently. Resources:
- product: Product details, variants (first/after) and media (mediaAfter). id: Product GID.
- collection: Collection details, rules and a page of products. id: Collection GID.
- order: Order, shipping, fulfillment, tracking and a page of line items. id: Order GID.
- inventory: Inventory by product (id: Product GID) or inventory item (id: InventoryItem GID, pages through locations).
- metafields: Metafields of any owner (id: owner GID); optional namespace and key.
- theme_files: Theme file contents. id: OnlineStoreTheme GID; optional filenames, else pages through every file.
- blog_articles: A blog's articles. id: Blog GID.
- uploaded_image: Image processing status and CDN URL. id: MediaImage GID.
- bulk_operation: A bulk operation's status and result URLs. id: BulkOperation GID. Partial exports stay marked incomplete.
- customer: Customer details, addresses, marketing consent state and a page of orders, newest first. id: Customer GID.
- draft_order: Draft order with status, totals, addresses and line items. id: DraftOrder GID.
- variants: Every variant field of a product (price, barcode, tax, inventory policy, weight, cost, origin, HS code, options) with first/after. id: Product GID.
- order_transactions: An order's payment transactions (authorizations, captures, refunds, voids). id: Order GID.
- order_refunds: An order's refunds with refunded items, restock status and transactions. id: Order GID.
- fulfillment_orders: An order's fulfillment orders with status, location, delivery method, holds and line items. id: Order GID.
- webhook: One webhook subscription of this app. id: WebhookSubscription GID.
- page: One Online Store page with its HTML body, handle, isPublished, publishedAt and templateSuffix. id: Page GID.
- article: One blog article with body, summary, author, tags, image, isPublished, publishedAt and its blog. id: Article GID.
- metaobject: One metaobject: handle, type, displayName, fields (key, type, value, jsonValue), updatedAt, capabilities. id: Metaobject GID.
- metaobject_definition: One metaobject definition with full field definitions and validations. id: MetaobjectDefinition GID.
- fulfillment: One fulfillment: status, tracking info (company, number, url), line items, location and createdAt. id: Fulfillment GID (from the order's fulfillments).
- discount: One discount in full: status, summary, dates, value, minimum requirement, who is eligible, items it covers, combinesWith, usage limits and usage, and the first 20 codes with a code count. id: DiscountNode, DiscountCodeNode or DiscountAutomaticNode GID.

id.description: The record's GID, such as gid://shopify/Product/123.

mediaAfter.description: product: cursor for the media page.

name: shopify_get
title: Get a Shopify Record
